args:
for root in "$CLAUDE_PLUGIN_ROOT" "$PLUGIN_ROOT"; do
  if [ -n "$root" ] && [ -f "$root/bin/communicate-mcp" ]; then
    exec bash "$root/bin/communicate-mcp"
  fi
done
data=$COMMUNICATE_DATA
[ -n "$data" ] || data="$HOME/.local/share/communicate"
if [ -f "$data/repo-path" ]; then
  IFS= read -r repo < "$data/repo-path"
  exec bash "$repo/plugins/communicate/bin/communicate-mcp"
fi
if [ -f "$data/current/src/cli.mjs" ]; then
  exec node "$data/current/src/cli.mjs" serve
fi
printf 'COM8: no installed payload found. Install a reviewed COM8 release and run com8 setup.\n' >&2
exit 127
